_comment: Cohort-specific expectations for the viewer pipeline. Copy to
cohort_config.json and fill in for your own cohort. cohort_config.json is
gitignored on purpose: unit ids, per-unit pathology labels and cohort
counts are study data, not code, and must not be committed.
Every key is optional. A missing key disables the check that uses it.

important_regions._comment: Manually curated important regions, keyed "<unit>|<slide>". cx_world/cy_world/r_um are original world microns; pdx is the region label drawn on the overlay.

expected._comment: Cohort-integrity checks in verify_viewer_features.py. Set to null to skip an individual check.

path_colors._comment: pathology label -> [background, foreground] chip colours; unlisted labels get neutral grey

naming._comment: Study-specific naming. file_prefix is prepended to every viewer filename; run_prefix maps a slide label to its AtoMx run folder.
